Drifting golden motes of light hang suspended in the air, rising slowly between the trees like sparks that never fade.
Luminous butterflies with softly glowing wings flutter through the glade, leaving faint trails of iridescent light behind them.
Petals fall in slow spirals through shafts of moonlight, each one catching a soft silver glow as it descends.
Gossamer threads float between the branches, catching the ambient light and trembling with every gentle, imperceptible breath of wind.
A shimmer of fairy-dust drifts lazily through the court, settling on shoulders and leaves alike in soft gold.
Tiny will-o-wisps bob and weave through the air, their pale blue flames flickering in no discernible breeze.
Wisps of soft luminous mist curl low along the ground, glowing faintly with a warm rose-tinged inner light.
Floating pollen drifts in slow eddies, each grain lit from within like a tiny ember refusing to extinguish.
Dewdrops hang impossibly still in midair, glittering like suspended gems catching the light of a thousand distant stars.
A faint aurora bleeds through the canopy above, casting shifting ribbons of green and violet across every upturned face.
Soft bioluminescence pulses along every surface — bark, stone, and petal alike breathing with a slow, rhythmic silver-blue glow.
Trailing ribbons of light unspool from passing wings, dissolving slowly into the air like whispered songs made briefly visible.
Faint sparks of cool white light drift upward from the mossy ground, rising like breath exhaled on a winter morning.
Translucent orbs of pale light drift at shoulder height, humming with an almost inaudible frequency that resonates in the chest.
Threads of silver mist weave between dancers, catching in the folds of gowns and refusing to fully dissipate or settle.
Soft aureoles of warm golden light pool around each torch flame, bleeding into the air in slow, honeyed halos.
Luminous spores drift from great pale mushrooms, spiraling upward through the canopy in slow, hypnotic, softly glowing columns.
Thin veils of enchanted fog layer the air at mid-height, each layer a different hue — pearl, lavender, and rose.
Cascading motes swirl in loose spirals wherever music plays, as though the sound itself has taken on shimmering visible form.
Firefly-sized lights drift in loose constellations through the court, their patterns slowly shifting into shapes that almost mean something.
A light rain of luminous silver sparks falls from nowhere, each mote vanishing the moment it touches skin or ground.
Glowing filaments stretch between blossoms like the finest web, trembling faintly and releasing small bursts of light when disturbed.
Soft clouds of iridescent shimmer hang near the fountains, each droplet of spray catching the enchantment and multiplying its glow.
Faint ghostly blooms materialize and dissolve in the air at eye level, their petals made entirely of soft diffused light.
The very air between the lanterns seems to thicken with magic, dense with a warm, barely visible golden luminescence.
